goal: Stabilise every zone of a multi-zone flood incident: each URGENT or CRITICAL zone receives assets or an explicit shortage escalation, every consequential action is signed off by a human, and no zone without evidence is dispatched to blind.

agents.coordinator: Coordinator: owns the goal, runs the loop, ranks zones, reflects on the run
agents.dispatcher: Tactical Dispatcher: perceives each zone through the Stage 01-04 tools and fuses the evidence
agents.allocator: Resource Allocator: turns ranked needs into reservations against a finite inventory
agents.auditor: Safety Auditor: applies the safety rules and routes anything consequential to a human
agents.commander: Human incident commander: approves, rejects, overrides or halts

START.description: Receive the incident picture: zones, raw inputs, inventory.

PLAN.description: Plan-and-execute: write the whole task plan from the evidence first, then check it for duplicate, missing or illegal steps.

PERCEIVE.description: Call one perception tool per evidence stream the zone actually has.

CONTEXTUALISE.description: Pull the district's flood history, and precedents from past runs (memory).

ASSESS.description: Fuse the evidence into one priority with conflicts and a review flag.

BRIEF.description: Condense the zone's incident log into a Stage 04 briefing.

RETRIEVE_SOP.description: Ground the response in the national SOP corpus.

ESCALATE_EVIDENCE.description: No usable evidence: request field verification, dispatch nothing.

RANK.description: Order zones by priority, fused score and estimated headcount.

ALLOCATE.description: Tree of thoughts: score alternative allocation plans and keep the best; then reserve units without over-committing.

DEBATE.description: Multi-agent debate and negotiation: zones bid for contested units, the Safety Auditor challenges the proposal, and the consensus is recorded.

AUDIT.description: Apply the safety rules to every proposed action.

AWAIT_APPROVAL.description: Hold consequential actions for a human sign-off.

MUTUAL_AID.description: Record every shortfall as a mutual-aid request and tell a human.

ALERT.description: Issue low-consequence standby alerts the auditor cleared automatically.

COMMIT.description: Commit an approved dispatch and notify the shelter, or release a rejected one.

REFLECT.description: Reflexion: check the goal, and revise the allocation once if units were freed while zones are still short.

OVERRIDE.description: Emergency override: a human halts the run or recalls a dispatch at any time.
